marketing_description: The NUVO 62-1852 Direct Wire Downlight from the Professional Series features a dimmable LED bulb with a color temperature of 4000 K and a color rendering index of 90+, providing a warm white to natural light color. This fixture is designed with a flat face recessed trim and a frosted polycarbonate lens, and is constructed with an aluminum body and a white finish. It is also air-tight, IC rated, and includes a remote driver.
